{{Top}}
A '''gastropod''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] that had no true [[Skeleton/Legends|skeletal]] frame and moved by means of a wide muscular foot, or whose body acted as one large foot.<ref name="NEGTAS xii">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'', p. xii</ref> Most gastropods [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduced]] [[Gender/Legends|asexually]].<ref name="NEGTAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> The [[Gastrulan]] of [[Gastrula]], and [[Exogorth/Legends|exogorths]], were gastropods.
